611	  /** Stamp, goal, standard, then the attempt loop; the session is flushed on every path. */
612	  private async drive(
613	    agent: Agent,
614	    definition: EnvironmentDefinition,
615	    stamp: EnvironmentRunStamp,
616	    request: EnvironmentRunRequest,
617	  ): Promise<EnvironmentRunReport> {
618	    const { goals, completionStandards, sessions } = this.ctx
619	    await agent.whenIdle()
620	    const runDirectory = await this.reserve(agent, definition)
621	    agent.session.append('environment/run', stamp)
622	    const goal = goals.create(agent, {
623	      objective: definition.task.prompt,
624	      ...this.resolved.maxGoalRounds === undefined ? {} : { maxGoalRounds: this.resolved.maxGoalRounds },
625	    })
626	    goals.disarm(agent)
627	    const authored = completionStandards.author(agent, { goalId: goal.id, checks: definition.checks })
628	    // Authorship validated every case against the reference it carries and kept
629	    // the reference alone; the bodies stay here, for the reservation and the
630	    // per-case execution.
631	    const bodies = new Map(definition.checks.flatMap(check => (
632	      check.caseBodies === undefined ? [] : [[check.id, check.caseBodies] as const]
633	    )))
634	    const immutable = definition.task.immutable ?? []
635	    // Stock the reservation and digest the check-owned set before the
636	    // implementer's first turn: that digest is what every later attempt is
637	    // compared against.
638	    await materializeChecks(runDirectory, authored, bodies)
639	    let checkOwned = await hashCheckOwned(request.workspace, runDirectory, immutable)
640	    const attempts: EnvironmentRunAttempt[] = []
641	    let certificate: VerificationCertificate | undefined
642	    let prompt = definition.task.prompt
643	    try {
644	      for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= this.resolved.maxAttempts; attempt += 1) {
645	        await this.deliver(agent, prompt)
646	        const standard = this.currentStandard(agent, goal.id)
647	        const ref = { id: standard.id, revision: standard.revision }
648	        if (await hashCheckOwned(request.workspace, runDirectory, immutable) !== checkOwned) {

651	        }

655	        // is the baseline the next attempt must still find.
656	        checkOwned = await hashCheckOwned(request.workspace, runDirectory, immutable)

658	        const outcome = completionStandards.recordRun(agent, ref, this.resolved.isolation, results, {
659	          executor: 'runner',
660	          treeHash,
661	        })
662	        attempts.push({ attempt, results, treeHash })
663	        if (outcome.certified) {

671	        }
672	        const directive = describeFailures(outcome.failures, standard.checks, this.resolved.evidenceMaxChars)

674	        prompt = followupText(directive)
675	      }

677	      await sessions.flush(agent.session)
678	    }
679	    const usage = totalUsage(agent.session.events)
680	    return {
681	      environment: definition.id,
682	      sessionId: agent.id,
683	      stamp,
684	      attempts,
685	      certified: certificate !== undefined,
686	      ...certificate === undefined ? {} : { certificate },
687	      ...usage === undefined ? {} : { usage },
688	    }
689	  }

863	      total: cases.length,
864	      weightPassed,

17	 * and comparison use this one representation.
18	 * @param header - the header to normalize (not mutated).
19	 * @returns the canonical header.
20	 */
21	export function canonicalHeader(header: EpochHeader): EpochHeader {
22	  const adapterDefaults = header.adapterDefaults
23	  return {
24	    config: header.config,
25	    ...adapterDefaults?.reasoningEffort === true || adapterDefaults?.maxTokens === true
26	      ? { adapterDefaults }
27	      : {},
28	    ...header.system !== undefined && header.system.length > 0 ? { system: header.system } : {},
29	    ...header.tools !== undefined && header.tools.length > 0 ? { tools: header.tools } : {},
30	  }

34	function sameSchema(a: ToolSchema, b: ToolSchema): boolean {
35	  return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b)

48	    || a.adapterDefaults?.maxTokens !== b.adapterDefaults?.maxTokens
49	    || a.system !== b.system

51	  const at = a.tools ?? []
